Private maximum sale value set in init().

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as _from in the allowance check and allowance deduction inside transferFrom.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the source of the delegated transferFrom call.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller address.
delegate gates on require(msg.sender == owner) before executing a delegatecall.
init gates on require(msg.sender == owner) before changing sale limits.
batchSend gates on require(msg.sender == owner) before moving balances.
setTradeAddress gates on require(msg.sender == owner).
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls require(ensure(_from, _to, _value)).
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when the address is not whitelisted.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value in its loop.
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b) on a user-supplied address, allowing full state takeover.
_value parameter flows into the balance and allowance updates of transferFrom.
_from parameter indexes balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom.
_to parameter indexes balanceOf in transferFrom.
_from parameter is checked against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure.
_value parameter is forwarded to condition within ensure.
_value parameter is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
_from parameter indexes _onSaleNum in condition.
balanceOf mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
allowance mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented by transferFrom.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
condition reads _onSaleNum and compares it to _saleNum.
condition reads the _saleNum limit.
condition reads the _minSale limit.
condition reads the _maxSale limit.
ensure consults the canSale whitelist mapping.
ensure whitelists the owner address directly.
ensure whitelists tradeAddress directly.
init scales token amounts using decimals.
delegate compares msg.sender against owner.
batchSend compares msg.sender against owner.
setTradeAddress compares msg.sender against owner.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
constructor sets totalSupply and mirrors it into balanceOf.
Address parameter a is the delegatecall target inside delegate.
Bytes parameter b is the delegatecall payload inside delegate.
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum in init.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale in init.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale in init.
_tos array drives the batchSend loop.
addr parameter is written into tradeAddress.
factory parameter is hashed into the pair address in pairFor.
tokenA parameter participates in the pair hash ordering.
tokenB parameter participates in the pair hash ordering.
_value parameter is multiplied by _tos.length in batchSend.
total local variable is used to validate and reduce the sender balance in batchSend.
total local flows into the unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only a transfer destination argument consumed directly by transferFrom.
_value is the amount argument validated and applied by transferFrom.
_from is the source address argument indexed by transferFrom.
address a is only used as the delegatecall target inside delegate.
bytes b is only used as the delegatecall payload inside delegate.
saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init.
token is only scaled into _minSale inside init.
maxToken is only scaled into _maxSale inside init.
_tos is only iterated inside the batchSend loop.
addr is only written to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress.
factory is only hashed inside pairFor.
tokenA is only used for pair ordering and hashing inside pairFor.
tokenB is only used for pair ordering and hashing inside pairFor.
total is a temporary product computed and consumed only within batchSend.
